description: This script extracts partitions from a disk image, verifies and mounts a logical volume, and performs filesystem checks and data extraction, primarily intended to automate the setup or analysis of an Android host image.
external_files: lvm Partition files (e.g., lvm.img, rootfs.img, boot.img)

methods.name: extract_image
methods.description: Extracts a specific partition from a disk image and saves it into an output file by calculating the partition's start and size, then using dd to copy the data.
